ai_review.summary: Immaculate soundboard capture of Europe ’72 with a flawless Pig‑led “Two Souls in Communion” performance
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as immaculate and virtually flawless, delivering crystal‑clear sound that lets listeners feel Pig’s heartfelt playing despite his poor health. Reviewers highlight the soaring “Two Souls in Communion” as a standout moment, indicating a high‑energy, emotionally charged show.

ai_rating.rationale: The single review rates the set 4 stars and emphasizes both excellent sound quality and a powerful performance, warranting a rating just above average but not maximal due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as immaculate and flawless; no technical flaws or mix issues mentioned.
